title: fix(runtime): the automation write doors keep a flow whose only package is disabled, whatever its package's enable state
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #34145

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

> **Widening:** `AutomationEngine.getHeldFlow(name)` is a new public method on a class `@objectstack/service-automation` exports from its `.` entry (seat rulings 6911640332 on #34145: R1 stands, R2 superseded, M1 = B). Nothing narrows: no `!`, no BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 marker.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/automation` 的四个写入口(克隆新名占用检查、写入被拒后的回填副本、PUT 与对已有名字的 POST 沿用的凭据、DELETE 存在性检查)对"仅一个包持有"的名字改读引擎新增的 `getHeldFlow`(按全部持有者判断)。对"两个包共有"的名字,`getHeldFlow` 拒绝后回落到服务视图 `getFlow`,行为与 main 相同(座席裁决 6911640332,M1 = B)。克隆入口把共有名字的拒绝捕获为自己的"名称已占用" 409。
- 为什么改:PR #34048 之后,唯一持有者的包被停用时 `getFlow` 答"无此流程",这四处问的却是持久问题,答案不应随包的启停而变。
- 风险与回滚:无收窄;新增公开方法 `getHeldFlow` 是放宽。唯一可见变化是:两包都启用时克隆到共有名字,原先抛出引擎拒绝,现在返回克隆入口自己的"名称已占用",状态码与 code 不变。两个持有包都被停用的共有名字,克隆入口仍不视为占用(与 main 相同,已在注释与 changeset 写明,后续卡由席位立)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 `heldFlowReader`(共有名字的回落)与 `cloneTargetHeld`;`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts` 末尾的 booted-kernel 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中含真实元数据协议保存用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`AutomationEngine.getHeldFlow(name)`** (service-automation, `engine.ts`): the flow the engine holds under a bare name, judged over every holder through `bareFlowKey`. A disabled sole holder is included. A name two packages hold is refused `409`. Like `getFlow`, it settles the name first (review#1 N1, in the docblock).
- **`heldFlowReader`** (runtime, `automation.ts`), used at the four write doors: the clone's taken-name probe, the `registerAndSaveFlow` put-back copy, `keepStoredFlowCredentials`, and the `unregisterAndDeleteFlow` existence probe.
  - It asks `getHeldFlow`.
  - If that raises `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (a name two packages hold), it falls back to `getFlow`, the served holder, as on `main` (M1 = B).
  - A service without `getHeldFlow` is asked its `getFlow`.
- **`cloneTargetHeld`**: the clone's probe catches the refusal of a name two served holders hold and answers it with the door's own name-taken `409`, as `flowWriteRefusal`'s clone arm does (L1 nit, review#1 S2).
- **For a flow whose only package is disabled**, the four doors return to the last release's answers:
  - clone onto the name: `409`;
  - put-back: the held body;
  - `PUT`, or `POST /` onto the name: keeps the stored credential;
  - `DELETE`: `200`.
- **For a name two packages hold**, the doors answer as on `main`. The one change is the both-enabled clone, which now gets the name-taken answer.
- **Stated, unchanged (review#1 delta 6915149305, S5 option 1):** a name two packages hold with BOTH holders disabled is not taken at the clone door, as on `main`: `getHeldFlow` refuses the shared name, the served fallback `getFlow` answers `null`, and the copy is admitted. The clone door's comment and the `#34145` changeset say so; no code path moves.
- **`.changeset/33905-disabled-sole-holder-flow.md`** (pending from PR #34048), corrected (L1 F3, review#1 S3).
  - Its three write-door bullets are replaced by one paragraph. It says those doors keep the last release's answers for a disabled sole holder, and read a name two packages hold on its served holder.
  - Every other line is byte-identical.
  - **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of the pending note `.changeset/33905-disabled-sole-holder-flow.md` (added by PR #34048, unreleased). Its paragraph "Three HTTP write doors ask `getFlow` whether the name is held, and move with it for such a flow." and its three bullets (clone admits the copy, put-back withdraws the name and drops the credential, `DELETE` answers `404`) would be false after this PR. The corrected sentences:
    > The HTTP write doors that ask a lasting question of the name do not move with it: the clone door's taken-name check on the new name, the definition a refused `POST /automation` or `PUT /automation/NAME` puts back, the stored credential a `PUT /automation/NAME` body, or a `POST /automation` body onto a name the engine holds, keeps when it leaves it out, and the `DELETE /automation/NAME` existence check read the flow the engine holds whatever its package's enable state. For such a flow the clone's new name is refused `409`, the held definition is put back, the credential is kept and `DELETE` answers a deletion, as before this release. A name two packages hold is read at those doors on its served holder, as the bare entries read it.
  - `check-empty-changeset` keeps `Check Changeset` red on this file until the dispatching seat's record confirms the correction (its ACCEPT or its same-head contract-review PASS); it is not restored from the base.

## Tests

- **Runtime**, `automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts`, through the real `HttpDispatcher`:
  - Clone: a disabled sole holder's name is taken. A shared name in each of three states (co-holder kept, co-holder withdrawn, both served) gets the door's returned name-taken `409`.
  - Put-back, credentials and `DELETE` for a disabled sole holder, each with CONTROLs.
  - Shared-name writes, as on `main`, with no store: `PUT` and `POST /` are admitted `200` into the served holder, and a served-form `PUT` keeps the served holder's secret. CONTROL: both holders enabled gives `409` naming every holder.
  - The with-store leg runs through the **real metadata protocol save on a booted kernel** (`MetadataPlugin`, `ObjectQLPlugin`, SQLite), with two authored packages each holding a stored flow row and one of them disabled. Package-less `PUT` and `POST` are expected to give `200`, with the edit in the enabled holder's row and the disabled holder's row byte-unchanged.
  - The no-store narrowing pins from the previous round are removed.
- **Engine**, `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts`:
  - `[#33905]`: `getHeldFlow` is the slot's body.
  - `[#33893]` withdrawn-slot case: `getHeldFlow` refuses naming both holders, while `getFlow` serves the enabled holder.
  - Uninstall stretch: `getHeldFlow` settles the name back to the one holder. This backs N1; it is no longer framed as a remedy.

## Acceptance notes

- **Review disposition, from both reviews:**
  - L1 F1 / review#1 S1: re-pinned under B.
  - L1 F2: moot; there is no narrowing and no remedy.
  - L1 F3 / review#1 S3: corrected under B.
  - L1 nit / review#1 S2: done.
  - review#1 M1: B applied.
  - review#1 S4: rulings recorded in 6911640332; the claim amendment is the area's.
  - review#1 N1: done.
  - review#1 delta 6915149305: S5 option 1 (exception stated in the clone door's comment and the changeset; no behaviour change), N2 (both changesets name `POST /automation` onto a held name beside `PUT` for the kept credential), N3 (this body). These three are prose-only: `e5468471` moves comments and changesets, no code path.
- **filed #34394**: both-disabled shared name at the clone door (review#1 6915149305 S5, stated here as the exception, as on main).
- The booted-kernel case passes on this head: the real protocol's package-less save addresses the enabled holder's flow row.

## Verification

Final head `e5468471` (takeover round, claim 6913100013). `e6f54de659` typed one test read's engine options; `e5468471` moves prose only (comments and changesets). Local runs under the shared verify lock, after rebuilding the `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/service-automation` closures.

**The three red checks on the hand-off head `fa24e9f67c`:**

- `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`, step `pnpm check:query-options-erasure`, first error: "test surface grew 236 → 237 site(s)". This PR's: `automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts` erased the booted-kernel rows read's options to `any`. Fixed in `e6f54de659`: the context rides the read's typed trailing options. Local gate: `test surface: 236 site(s) in 47 file(s) — at the ceiling`, exit 0. CI at `e5468471`: success.
- `Lint & Repo Gates`, step `verify-lanes`, first error: "lint lane `lint-scoped-erasure` concluded `failure`". The aggregator of the lane above, nothing of its own. CI at `e5468471`: success.

Red by design: the DELIBERATE CORRECTION declared under What changes. Every other step passes in CI and locally: `check-changeset-no-major` with an event carrying the current title and this body, exit 0 ("LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes (widening)` and metadata-protocol `none` … a non-protocol change at `patch`"); `check-adr-0087-registration`, exit 0 ("this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (2 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)").

Anchor 1 → 0, blob `17d55e44ce60` → `ab01b636efef`. Result: Tests 5 failed, 17 passed (22). Red: `PUT /:name` and `POST /` with no metadata store (admitted 200 into the served holder), `PUT /:name` in the served form keeping the served holder's secret, and the booted-kernel `PUT` and `POST` (200 into the enabled holder's row). Restored: blob after restore `17d55e44ce60` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
